title: Omar's sister
subtitle: A video call from Amman — and words for people
canDo: I can use 's: Omar's sister, Sam's café.
I can describe people: tall, young, funny, quiet…
I can understand a short video call.
teacherNotes: 's'nin iki anlamını mutlaka ayırın: Omar's tall (= Omar is tall) / Omar's sister (= Omar'ın kız kardeşi). Tahtada iki renkle gösterin.
Türk öğrenciler için iyelik sırası Türkçeyle aynı (Omar'ın kız kardeşi = Omar's sister). Arap öğrenciler için sıra ters (أخت عمر = Omar's sister); bunu özellikle vurgulayın.
Sıfatlar: öğrencilere sınıftan birini veya ünlü birini 2 sıfatla anlattırın ("He's tall and funny").
Çoğul iyelik (my parents' house) bu seviyede sadece tanıma amaçlı; üretmelerini beklemeyin.

sections.title: Warm-up
prompts: Do you have a brother or a sister?
Is he or she tall or short?
Is your best friend funny or quiet?

items.example: She's a student at the University of Jordan.

sections.title: Listen and read
sections.heading: A video call
sections.scene: Sam's café. Omar's phone rings. It's his sister, Lina, in Amman.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Elif, look — it's my sister, Lina. Say hi!

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Hi, Lina! I'm Elif, Omar's classmate.

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: Hi, Elif! Nice to meet you. Is my brother a good student?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Yes, he is! He's very smart, and he's never late.

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: Really? At home, he's always late!

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: Elif, is that the famous café? Sam's café?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Yes, it is! Sam's coffee is great.

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: Say hello to Sam from Omar's little sister!

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: People in my life

sections.title: Grammar: 's (Omar's sister)
rules: Person + **'s** + thing or person: **Sam's** café, **Omar's** sister
Plural words with -s: add only **'** — my parent**s'** apartment
Be careful! **'s** can also be **is**: Omar**'s** tall. (= Omar is tall)

support.tr: "Omar'ın kız kardeşi" demek için isme 's ekleriz: Omar's sister. Türkçedeki -ın / -in gibidir ve sıra da aynıdır. Ama İngilizcede ikinci kelimeye ek gelmez: kardeş-i değil, sadece sister. Dikkat: 's bazen is'in kısaltmasıdır: Omar's tall = Omar uzun boylu.
support.ar: في الإنجليزية نضيف 's إلى اسم المالك: Omar's sister = أختُ عمر. الترتيب عكس العربية: المالك أولًا ثم الشيء (Sam's café = مقهى سام). وانتبه: 's قد تكون اختصارًا لـ is: Omar's tall = عمر طويل.

ar.note: في العربية نقول «مقهى سام» (الشيء أولًا)، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول Sam's café (المالك أولًا).

items.audio: My brother Omar is tall and quiet. He's very smart.
This is Rose's apartment. Her cat's name is Tom.
Lucas's guitar is always in my classroom!

sections.prompt: Write about three people in your life. Use 's and two adjectives.

support.tr: Hayatındaki üç kişiyi yaz. 's ve iki sıfat kullan.
support.ar: اكتب عن ثلاثة أشخاص في حياتك. استخدم 's وصفتين.

checklist: I use 's one or two times.
I use two adjectives for every person.
